spine-top.what: the spine from above: a long orange armour body, narrow neck to the right widening to broad shoulders and a flared tail on the left, with engraved plate breaks and a hatch outline near the tail

pod-top-port.what: the port armour pod from above: a broad orange armour block with chamfered corners, front edge to the right, with an engraved step line and plate break

pod-top-stbd.what: the starboard armour pod from above (mirror)

drive-top-port.what: the port drive pod from above: a light grey machinery housing, front to the right, with a collar groove and an access panel outline

drive-top-stbd.what: the starboard drive pod from above (mirror)

underside.what: the whole belly from below: the orange spine and armour pods, the grey drive pods

drive-side-port.what: the port drive pod's outboard side: a light grey machinery housing wall

drive-side-stbd.what: the starboard drive pod's outboard side (mirror)

cheek-port.what: the port armour pod's grey outer cheek from outboard, with a three-slot louvre

bow.what: the bow faces from dead ahead: the two orange armour pods' front faces either side of the spine

stern.what: the stern faces from dead astern: the orange spine tail between the two grey drive pod tails
